name: donkey-master-and-uno-game
description: Multiplayer Card Game featuring Donkey Master and UNO Show 'Em No Mercy with Android APK build support

scripts.client:sync: npm --prefix client run build && npx --prefix client cap sync android
scripts.build:web: npm --prefix client run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.rmSync('server/public/assets', {recursive: true, force: true}); fs.cpSync('client/dist', 'server/public', {recursive: true, force: true}); console.log('Successfully exported web build to server/public');"
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run server:build

author: Thala Dinesh
